name: B2B CRM
description: A shared account, contact, activity, and review-first sales pipeline workspace.

agentPrompts.label: Give me today's CRM overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `b2b-crm` skill in this folder, then give me today's overview: follow-ups due, deals by stage with exact counts, and accounts by Relationship Type. State when a metric is bounded by a loaded page rather than a full scan.

agentPrompts.label: Brief me on an account before I reach out
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `b2b-crm` skill in this folder, then brief me on the company I name: its Relationship Type, primary contacts, most recent activities, and any open deals, so I have context before a call or email.

agentPrompts.label: Log a change to a company, contact, activity, or deal
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `b2b-crm` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then propose the company, contact, activity, or deal change I describe as a ChangeRequest, reusing canonical record ids for any relation fields, and give me the ChangeRequest id to review.
